title: The generic 'leave be' template ignores grammatical number and person: 'You give toll-men a wide berth. It holds its ground' uses singular 'It' for two men, and the same template calls the named Quartermaster Coll 'It' rather than 'he'.
where: The Toll Stand (Thornwold) / leave toll-men be; the Sack Road Camp — fire (Hearthlands) / leave Quartermaster Coll be

evidence.quote: The generic 'leave be' template ignores grammatical number and person: 'You give toll-men a wide berth. It holds its ground' uses singular 'It' for two men, and the same template calls the named Quartermaster Coll 'It' rather than 'he'.
